trigger: TRAIN t0001 diagonal response is repeatable at960Hz but fails480/960/1920Hz timestep refinement; force impulses, captured states and clocks pass independent checks
immediate_policy: Complete active diagnostic cases. Stop calibration capture at a case boundary. Suspend additional predictive fitting, bulk capture and active-policy comparison until numerical reliability is assessed.
roles: TRAIN-only engineering diagnosis, never weight fitting or calibration targets

required_checks.repeatability: Record fresh independent exact960Hz replay and all actual authored solver settings
required_checks.rates: At least3 physics-rate levels with matched mesh, hardware, solver settings, cameras and world-space force-time impulse
required_checks.iterations: At least3 deformable solver-iteration levels with matched rate and all other settings
required_checks.translation: Matched physical scene with world-coordinate translation; undo translation before comparison
required_checks.coverage: All4 declared TRAIN support families before large-scale replacement capture or reliability claims; a single t0001 factorial is diagnostic only

primary_engineering_acceptance.metric: Full-trajectory coordinate RMSE between matched saved states
primary_engineering_acceptance.refinement: Finest successive difference must be below fixed tolerance; both successive differences may be below tolerance, otherwise require the finer difference smaller than the coarser difference
primary_engineering_acceptance.translation: Matched translated/untranslated states must agree within the same fixed tolerance
primary_engineering_acceptance.other_metrics: Report velocities, extrema of nodal displacement, volume ratios, amplitude and temporal traces; do not invent outcome-dependent pass thresholds

unchanged_checks: Existing force-command, nominal/midpoint impulse, float32-dt clock,2um sensor-state, positive-volume and reset checks remain mandatory. Menu naming adapters must preserve every validation test and their executed source.
qualification: Predeclared practical engineering acceptance, not a mathematical convergence proof. Passing timestep/iteration/translation checks does not establish mesh convergence, attachment-model fidelity or continuum material accuracy.
preservation: Keep all prior960Hz data, models and sealed evidence as fixed-discretization experimental results. Publish failures and source hashes. Do not silently overwrite the old worker, dataset or confirmation plan.
